criteria.why: The whole form is passed as Scaffold's `body` prop, which does not exist (body must be JSX children), so nothing is rendered: an empty Scaffold.
Heading and both fields are inside the ignored `body` prop and never appear (the subtree itself would have been correct).
Button is inside the ignored `body` prop and never appears (stretch Column would have made it full-width).
Button is never rendered, so there is no disabled/enabled state to see (the onPressed null logic itself is right).
Helper text is inside the ignored `body` prop and never appears (the condition and placement are right).
No button on screen to tap, so onSubmit can never be called.

runtime.why: No exception; it renders a blank Scaffold because the `body` prop is dropped.

runtime.why: Material(transparency) > Center > ConstrainedBox(maxWidth 320) > Padding > Column(min, stretch) gets a bounded width, so stretch is safe; TextFields have a Material ancestor.
